🦠 How does Human Metapneumovirus (#HMPV) spread?
🔹 Airborne droplets from coughs or sneezes 🤧
🔹 Close contact with infected individuals 🤝
🔹 Touching contaminated surfaces & then touching your face 
Stay safe—wash hands, cover coughs, and disinfect often! 💙 #StayHealthy https://t.co/0D4pm4nD4o
